popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus makes Nicippe daughter of Pelops and wife of Sthenelus — mother of Eurystheus, the premature king Hera raises against Heracles.

popCulture.title: Nicippe
popCulture.description: Queen of Mycenae by Sthenelus — also called Antibia or Archippe — mother of the Eurystheus who assigns the Twelve Labours.

popCulture.title: Eurystheus
popCulture.description: Nicippe's son — born early by Hera's trick so he, not Heracles, holds the Argolid throne and the right to command the labours.

popCulture.title: Sthenelus
popCulture.description: Nicippe's husband, son of Perseus — the king whose Pelopid marriage ties Mycenae to Pelops' house through Eurystheus' mother.
